What We Offer

Specialised Medical Services

Comprehensive ENT and paediatric care under one roof, delivered by experienced specialists using advanced technology.

ENT Disorders

Expert diagnosis and treatment of ear infections, hearing loss, tinnitus, vertigo, and all ear-related conditions for patients of all ages.

Ear · Nose · Throat

Nasal & Sinus Care

Advanced management of sinusitis, nasal polyps, deviated septum, allergic rhinitis, and endoscopic sinus surgeries.

Nasal · Sinus

Throat & Voice

Specialised care for tonsillitis, adenoid problems, laryngitis, voice disorders, and throat conditions with minimally invasive procedures.

Throat · Voice

Paediatric ENT

Child-friendly ENT services including grommets, adenoidectomy, speech delay evaluation, and neonatal hearing screening.

Paediatric
🩺

Children's Medicine

Comprehensive paediatric consultations covering growth, nutrition, vaccines, infectious diseases and developmental assessments.

Paediatrics
🔬

Diagnostics & Audiology

In-house audiometry, tympanometry, BERA, OAE, nasal endoscopy, and digital X-ray for accurate and timely diagnosis.

Diagnostics
